summary: Blocking: planned monthly and promotion experiments share one fingerprint. plan_experiment.py fingerprint_payload omits tier, and both tiers select the same 23 regression cases at 3 attempts for a full-role variant (verified for qwen-3.7-high; monthly and promotion fingerprints are identical). A completed monthly run therefore marks the promotion candidate completed, and build_plan rejects promotion with 'no unique contender remains for this tier and evaluator revision', so a variant that passed scheduled monthly certification cannot be promoted. Blocking: the automated model/thinking promotion quality-win path is unreachable. run-experiment.sh sets suite=regression for promotion and asserts pass^3 for both incumbent and contender before comparison, so both pass_at_1_rate values are 1.0; compare_reports can return only efficiency-win or no-improvement, never the documented 'win'. Higher-cost higher-quality variants (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol-high, 3x incumbent cost) can never pass the promotion Gate. Both findings are reproduced from the exact reviewed SHA.
